$comment: IMPORTANT — no PHI passes through cron-job.org. Every job is a trigger:
it tells the backend to recompute something. Payloads carry a timestamp
and a nonce, responses carry counts. No patient identifier, name, date of
birth, location, or clinical detail ever appears in a URL, header, body,
or response body. cron-job.org is not a Business Associate and must never
be in a position to need one.
Each request is signed with HMAC-SHA256 over `{timestamp}.{body}` using
the key in Secrets Manager (see the CronSecretArn stack output). The
Lambda rejects signatures older than five minutes, so a captured request
All schedules are UTC. cron-job.org schedules in the account timezone —
set the account to UTC, or shift these to match.

commonSettings.$comment_saveResponses: Off deliberately. Responses are counts today, but a stored response body is a place PHI could later leak into.
commonSettings.$comment_redirect: A redirect would drop the signature headers, so it must fail loudly rather than silently retry unauthenticated.

jobs.title: Sineobex — analytics rollup
jobs.why: Keeps the Insights screen's aggregates warm so the endpoint is a single indexed read rather than a scan over every encounter.

jobs.title: Sineobex — hotspot recompute
jobs.why: Re-clusters the last 90 days of encounter geography with PostGIS DBSCAN. Six-hourly because a hotspot that shifts within one shift is noise, not signal; the :15 offset keeps it clear of the hourly rollup.

jobs.title: Sineobex — seasonal demand model
jobs.why: Rebuilds the twelve-month supply demand model from two years of usage. Overnight because it reads the full encounter history.

jobs.title: Sineobex — follow-ups due
jobs.why: Queues reminders for follow-ups due within a day, timed to land before the morning shift rather than overnight. The queued notification carries a patient id and nothing else — a lock-screen preview must not disclose a name or a diagnosis.

jobs.title: Sineobex — low stock alerts
jobs.why: Flags items below their minimum with no order outstanding, and notifies team leads. Four-hourly so a van that runs out mid-shift is caught before the next one departs; deduplicated to one alert per item per 24 hours so leads keep reading them.

jobs.title: Sineobex — audit archive
jobs.why: Marks audit rows older than 90 days for export to the Object Lock archive bucket, which retains them for the six years HIPAA §164.316(b)(2)(i) requires. Rows are marked, never deleted here — the row is only removed once the S3 object is confirmed durable.
